test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following bar graph shows the amount of money spent on various sports by a school administration in a particular year. The amount spent on Hockey and Football is what percent of the amount spent on Basketball and Tennis?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/066e6aca29c721425b4d9382196eddf3c0b4871a97e664cc1e5260731584af14.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

According to the question:

The amount spent on Hockey and Football = 80 + 100 = 180

The amount spent on Basketball and Tennis = 150 + 50 = 200

Required % = 180/200 × 100 = 90%.

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
